# Character consistency

**Make her the same person every time: ref pack, identity block, per-model reference tricks, drift scoring and fixes.**

Keeps an AI character (Claudia or your own) recognisably the same person across hundreds of images and videos and across different models — identity blocks, a 12-shot reference pack, per-model reference mechanics (Nano Banana refs, GPT Image edits, FLUX.2 multi-reference, Seedream batches, Midjourney omni reference, image-to-video first frames), seeds, drift scoring, and edit-based fixes for face drift, teenage-looking drift, extra hair streaks, hands and text artifacts. Use when starting a new character, when outputs start to drift, when switching models, or before a batch run.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 45 min (ref pack) · 2 min per check | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Lock the text identity
2. Build the 12-shot reference pack
3. Use each model's reference mechanism correctly
4. Use seeds for experiments, not for identity
5. Score every output
6. Carry identity into video
7. Fix with edits, not rerolls
8. Record what worked

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/character-consistency.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/character-consistency.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/character-consistency.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/character-consistency.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill character-consistency`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `character-consistency.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/character-consistency`.
